How to Make a Photo Collage for Social Media Without an App

Published November 5, 2026 · Ubahin Team

A collage helps you show several photos in one post: before and after, product variations, or a roundup of an event. You do not need a special app; a browser is enough.

Choose a layout

The automatic layout arranges photos into a grid. For two "before and after" photos, choose two columns. For a row of products, choose one row. For a vertical story, choose one column.

Steps

  1. Open Photo Collage Maker and select 2 to 12 photos.
  2. Set the order with the arrow buttons; the first photo goes in the first cell.
  3. Choose the layout, the shape of each photo, the spacing between photos, the background color, and the width of the result.
  4. Tap process, then download.

Tips

  • Use the same orientation for all photos (all portrait or all landscape) so the collage looks tidy. If needed, tidy them first with Crop Image.
  • Use small spacing and a white background for a clean look.
  • If the result is too large to upload, shrink it with Resize Image.

Copyright

Only use photos that you own or have the right to use.
